title: Okkake-daisen-tsugi (mochidashi)
jp: 追掛け大栓継ぎ（持ち出し継ぎ）
guidance: A long half-lap splice in which each tenon runs past the other timber's shoulder: its nose is carried out 20 mm proud of the surface into a shallow rebate, and two 大栓 driven down through the lap pin the two halves together.
